handoffs.trigger: Any allocation, pricing, or capacity question that needs an optimizer
handoffs.output: formal objective, variables, constraints, data map
handoffs.never: never solves with undeclared constraints

handoffs.trigger: Inventory-to-demand allocation (extends `0023`'s LP)
handoffs.evidence: lendable inventory, borrow demand, fees, caps
handoffs.never: never ignores the balance-sheet cap (`0023` AC)

handoffs.trigger: Allocation with minimum lot sizes, counterparty count limits, or all-or-nothing loans
handoffs.evidence: same as LP plus lot/limit data
handoffs.never: never reports a MIP gap as optimal

handoffs.trigger: Cheapest-to-deliver collateral, substitutions, margin under schedules (`0067` contract)
handoffs.evidence: collateral holdings, eligibility, haircuts, margin calls
handoffs.never: never breaches eligibility or concentration schedules

handoffs.trigger: Fee-setting for warm/special names, tiered counterparty pricing
handoffs.evidence: PIT fee history, utilization, demand elasticity estimates
handoffs.output: proposed fee grid with expected revenue range
handoffs.never: never reprices; proposals only

handoffs.trigger: Balance-sheet, RWA, or lending-capacity budgeting across programs
handoffs.evidence: capacity limits, balances, returns on capacity
handoffs.never: never exceeds declared limits

handoffs.trigger: Allocations that must survive recall or demand uncertainty
handoffs.output: robust allocation and cost of robustness
handoffs.never: never hides the uncertainty set

handoffs.trigger: **Every** solve above
handoffs.never: never certifies a solve it cannot reproduce

handoffs.trigger: Adopter's in-house allocation or collateral engine
handoffs.never: never inspects proprietary logic

handoffs.trigger: Short-side or lending-program risk profile
handoffs.never: never states return without the risk story

handoffs.trigger: Exposure to borrowers net of collateral and indemnification
handoffs.evidence: loans, collateral marks, netting sets, limits
handoffs.output: netted, collateralized exposure, PFE with horizon
handoffs.never: never lets gross exposure stand for net

handoffs.trigger: Cash-collateral reinvestment, recall-driven liquidity needs
handoffs.evidence: cash collateral balances, reinvestment holdings, recall forecasts
handoffs.output: liquidity gap and stress with stated basis
handoffs.never: never reports a liquidity number without its basis

handoffs.trigger: Fails, buy-ins, late returns, booking breaks
handoffs.evidence: fails and buy-in records, recall timelines
handoffs.never: never classifies a developing event as a loss

handoffs.trigger: The plugin's own models and the grounding pipeline once used for decisions
handoffs.never: never approves its own validation

handoffs.trigger: Shortable universe for a strategy
handoffs.never: never uses today's borrow status historically

handoffs.trigger: Locate, Reg SHO, restricted-list, and lending-guideline checks
handoffs.evidence: locates, restricted lists, client lending guidelines
handoffs.never: never waives a constraint

handoffs.trigger: Short-side implementability under borrow and funding
handoffs.never: never assumes free borrow

handoffs.trigger: Borrow-cost and recall risk inside the portfolio risk budget
handoffs.never: never reallocates budget itself

handoffs.trigger: Rebalances that open or cover shorts
handoffs.never: never sends orders

handoffs.trigger: Borrow cost and lending income in portfolio results; reviews C-08's revenue attribution
handoffs.never: never omits costs

handoffs.trigger: Borrow-derived signals (utilization, fee moves, short interest) entering PM decisions
handoffs.never: never admits a signal without PIT proof

handoffs.trigger: Domain term or desk-procedure lookup
handoffs.never: never answers without a source

handoffs.trigger: Onboarding desk runbooks, data dictionaries, and schema docs that explain the query repository
handoffs.never: never ingests restricted material into a lower tier

handoffs.trigger: Dedup, conflict, and staleness across exemplars, metric definitions, and glossary terms
handoffs.output: canonical choices, conflict and gap list
handoffs.never: never resolves a conflict without a canonical source

handoffs.trigger: Accepted answers, corrections, and recurring desk questions
handoffs.never: never persists unreviewed claims

handoffs.trigger: Defining targets: "goes special within h days", "recalled within h days", demand level
handoffs.output: label spec with horizon and leakage review
handoffs.never: never labels with information after the decision time

handoffs.trigger: Reusable PIT borrow features (utilization, fee momentum, days-to-cover, recall rate)
handoffs.never: never serves a feature without its as-of

handoffs.trigger: Borrow demand, utilization, fee forecasts
handoffs.never: never reports a forecast without a naive baseline

handoffs.trigger: Specials and recall classifiers
handoffs.never: never reports uncalibrated probabilities

handoffs.trigger: Unusual fee, utilization, or recall patterns; unusual query-rejection patterns
handoffs.never: never treats an anomaly as a confirmed event

handoffs.trigger: Every model above
handoffs.never: never selects on in-sample results

handoffs.trigger: Effect of a fee or recall-policy change on demand or revenue
handoffs.never: never presents correlation as effect

handoffs.trigger: Exemplar ranking for `queries.search` if lexical retrieval underperforms on the golden set
handoffs.never: never ranks unreviewed exemplars above reviewed

handoffs.trigger: Drift and decay of deployed borrow models
handoffs.never: never retrains silently

handoffs.trigger: A deep file-level investigation of a research extract is wanted (hypotheses, anomaly scoring)
handoffs.evidence: bounded extract snapshot and the research bundle
handoffs.never: never treats an extract as the population

handoffs.trigger: Research findings need a data-quality review before a dataset feeds research or production
handoffs.output: quality review and accepted contract rules
handoffs.never: never accepts a contract rule without review

handoffs.trigger: compare_reference reports added, removed, or retyped columns
handoffs.never: never applies a schema change
